{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |CoachRank= 6 |APRank= |year =2016–17 |team =South Carolina Gamecocks |sport=Basketball |image =South Carolina Gamecocks logo.svg |image_size =125 |conference =Southeastern Conference |short_conf =SEC |record = 26–11 |conf_record = 12–6 |head_coach =[[Frank Martin (basketball)|Frank Martin]] |hc_year = 5th |asst_coach1 = [[Matt Figger]] |asst_coach2 = [[Perry Clark]] |asst_coach3 = Bruce Shingler |stadium=[[Colonial Life Arena]] |champion= Brooklyn Hoops Holiday Invitational champions |tourney=[[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Final Four }} {{2016–17 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of South Carolina]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team's head coach, [[Frank Martin (basketball)|Frank Martin]], was in his fifth season at South Carolina. The team played its home games at [[Colonial Life Arena]] in [[Columbia, South Carolina]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 26–11, 12–6 in SEC play to finish in a tie for third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2017 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2016–17 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]], [[2016–17 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]], [[2016–17 Baylor Bears basketball team|Baylor]] and SEC member Florida to advance to their first final four in school history where they lost to [[2016–17 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]]. Their final total of 26 wins is the most wins in school history. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|Gamecocks]] finished the season 25–9, 11–7 in SEC play to finish in a three-way tie for third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2015–16 Georgia Bulldogs basketball team|Georgia]]. They were invited to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 High Point Panthers men's basketball team|High Point]] in the first round to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2015–16 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team|Georgia Tech]]. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
